title: One Piece
blurb: As a child, Monkey D. Luffy was inspired to become a pirate by listening to the tales of the buccaneer "Red-Haired" Shanks. But his life changed when Luffy accidentally ate the Gum-Gum Devil Fruit and gained the power to stretch like rubber...at the cost of never being able to swim again! Years later, still vowing to become the king of the pirates, Luffy sets out on his adventure...one guy alone in a rowboat, in search of the legendary "One Piece," said to be the greatest treasure in the world...

title: Osananajimi Kanojo no Morahara ga Hidoi n de Zetsuen Sengen Shite Yatta: Jibun Rashiku Ikiru Koto ni Shitara, Naze ka Tonari no Seki no Kakure Bishoujo kara Kokuhaku Sareta
blurb:
My childhood friend is also my girlfriend. A dream come true, right? Hell no. She insults me on a daily basis. She grinds my dignity into shreds and it takes a toll on my mental well-being. I can’t take it anymore.

So I’m left with no choice, I’m going to break up with her. In order to maintain my sanity, it’s the only option.

And thus, the story of my break up begins…

title: Kingdom
blurb: Xin is a war orphan in a poor village in the kingdom of Qin. He has big dreams of becoming a great general, and when his best friend’s life is cut short by political machinations, Xin sets off to find a deposed ruler and help restore his place on the throne, while working his way up through the ranks of the Qin kingdom’s army to do what no one has ever done before—unify China.

title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity
blurb: This story takes place in a particular town with two infamous schools in constant dispute: Chidori High, a boys' school predominantly attended by low-class students with damning grades, and its neighbor Kikyo Girls' High, with most of its female students coming from wealthy and prestigious families. One day, high school second-year Rintaro Tsumugi, a fierce-looking but gentle-minded student at Chidori, is helping at his family's patisserie when he encounters a female customer by the name of Kaoruko Waguri. Rintaro enjoys his time with Kaoruko, as she doesn't judge him for his appearance, but this blissful peace is quickly disturbed when Rintaro makes the discovery that Kaoruko is actually a student at Kikyo. This revelation marks the beginning of the two's strenuous tale, as they fight against the limitations placed upon them by their schools and surroundings in an attempt to find their own path!

title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World’s Strongest
blurb: When a classroom of students is transported to another world to act as its saviors, Hajime Nagumo finds himself the weakest link. As his friends and classmates are granted strong classes and impressive abilities due to their existing skills, he is given the weak title of Synergist. When a dungeon quest leaves him separated from his group, Hajime must discover his own talents or be left to rot in this world forever.

title: Girls x Vampire
blurb:
"Yes! Yes! I finally bit one!"

Luluna Von Bettelheim, four-hundred-year-old vampire of noble lineage, wakes from her long slumber, and on a whim, enrolls in a human school. There she bites a girl and gains a servant. "Shower me with praise!" she orders. But her command leads to even more affection an she expected. Teren Mikami (prose) and Minori Chigusa (manga) team up to bring you a sensual girls' comedy about a vampire and her cute, high-school servant Wakana.



Note: Originally self-published on Twitter and note, was then licensed by Akita Shoten for serialization.

title: Boruto: Two Blue Vortex
blurb: With everyone's memories having been altered, Boruto finds himself being hunted by his own village. After escaping with Sasuke, what future awaits Boruto...?

title: Blue Lock
blurb:
After a disastrous defeat at the 2018 World Cup, Japan's team struggles to regroup. But what's missing? An absolute Ace Striker, who can guide them to the win. The Japan Football Union is hell-bent on creating a striker who hungers for goals and thirsts for victory, and who can be the decisive instrument in turning around a losing match...and to do so, they've gathered 300 of Japan's best and brightest youth players. Who will emerge to lead the team...and will they be able to out-muscle and out-ego everyone who stands in their way?



Note: Winner of the 45th Kodansha Manga Award in the Shounen Category in 2021.

title: Shodai-sama no Kikan: Shijou Saikyou ga 1000-nengo no Shison ni Tensei Suru
blurb: Gilphas Eldragon, the founding patriarch of the Eldragon family, dedicated his entire life to the pursuit of absolute strength. In search of eternal combat, he consumed a legendary fruit rumored to grant immortality under the protection of the divine dragon. Yet the rumor was false—Gilphas aged, and in the end, passed away in his son’s arms. Or so it seemed. When he next opened his eyes, Gilphas found himself reborn a thousand years later as Zeke Eldragon, heir to his own bloodline. But the world had changed: the Eldragon clan now thrived under a ruthless creed of survival of the fittest, and a new threat known as the “Chaos” loomed over humanity. Faced with an unfamiliar era and even greater enemies, the ancient warrior feels only exhilaration. For Gilphas—now Zeke—this is the chance he longed for: “This time, I will witness the true end of martial strength!”

title: Sakamoto Days
blurb: Taro Sakamoto was the ultimate assassin, feared by villains and admired by hitmen. But one day...he fell in love! Retirement, marriage, fatherhood and then... Sakamoto gained weight! The chubby guy who runs the neighborhood store is actually a former legendary hitman! Can he protect his family from danger? Get ready to experience a new kind of action comedy series!

title: One-Punch Man
blurb: In this new action-comedy, everything about a young man named Saitama screams "AVERAGE,” from his lifeless expression, to his bald head, to his unimpressive physique. However, this average-looking fellow doesn't have your average problem... He's actually a superhero that's looking for tough opponents! The problem is, every time he finds a promising candidate he beats the snot out of them in one punch. Can Saitama finally find an evil villain strong enough to challenge him? Follow Saitama through his hilarious romps as he searches for new bad guys to challenge!

title: The Salty Koharu Has a Soft Spot for Me
blurb:
"Satou Koharu is a pretty girl that everyone can recognize."

But her attitude with anyone is so bitter that she got nicknamed “Salt-God Sato-san." Anyone who tried to get close to her got emotionally injured in a brutal way. Though for some reason, I was able to save Sato-san from some pick-up boys where I was working at. Which made her like me, and thus I became a friend of “Salt-god Sato-san.” In front of everyone, she is a salt-god, but in front of me, she is very sweet. This is a high school life story of Satou-san and I.

title: Gachiakuta
blurb: A boy lives in a floating town, where the poor scrape by and the rich live a sumptuous life, simply casting their garbage off the side, into the abyss. When he’s falsely accused of murder, though, his wrongful conviction leads to an unimaginable punishment—exile off the edge, with the rest of the trash. Down on the surface, the cast-off waste of humanity has bred vicious monsters, and to travel the path to vengeance against those who cast him into Hell, a boy will have to become a warrior…

title: Kagurabachi
blurb:
Young Chihiro spends his days training under his famous swordsmith father. One day he hopes to become a great sword-maker himself. The goofy father and the serious son--they thought these days would last forever. But suddenly, tragedy strikes. A dark day soaked in blood. Chihiro and his blade now live only for revenge.


Note:
- Winner of the Tsugimanga 2024 Award in the Print Manga Category. 
- Winner of the 4th Magademy Commitment Award. 
- Nominee of the 70th Shogakukan Award.

title: Haimiya Is Scary Cute
blurb:
At my high school, everyone fears Haimiya-senpai. With her sharp piercings, striking grey wolf-cut, and that brutally honest Kansai dialect, she has a reputation for being downright terrifying. Yet, for some mysterious reason...this intimidating upperclassman is kind and gentle only to me! The curtain rises upon this heart-fluttering romantic comedy about a terrifying-yet-sweet senpai!


Note: Won 3rd place in the Next Manga Award 2026 Web Manga Category.

title: Ichi the Witch
blurb:
Magic is alive and well in the world, inside beings known as Majiks. By completing a Majik’s trial, a Witch can gain its power. However, only women can become Witches or use magical items. All that changes one day when a young man named Ichi turns the world on its head by defeating an infamous Majik and gaining its magical powers!



Notes:
- Winner of the 2025 Next Manga Award in the Print Manga Category.
- Ranked 11th in Da Vinci's 2025 Book of the Year ranking.
- Ranked 4th in the Men's Division of Takarajimasha's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! 2026 guidebook.
- Ranked 10th in the 19th Manga Taisho in 2026.
- Nominated for the 50th Kodansha Manga Award in the Shounen Category in 2026.

title: Witch Hat Atelier
blurb:
In a world where everyone takes wonders like magic spells and dragons for granted, Coco is a girl with a simple dream: she wants to be a witch. But everybody knows magicians are born, not made, and Coco was not born with a gift for magic. Resigned to her un-magical life, Coco is about to give up on her dream to become a witch … until the day she meets Qifrey, a mysterious, traveling magician. After secretly seeing Qifrey perform magic in a way she’s never seen before, Coco soon learns what everybody “knows” might not be the truth, and discovers that her magical dream may not be as far away as it may seem...




Notes:
- Nominated for the 11th Manga Taishou Award in 2018.
- Won the Daruma d'Or at Japan Expo in 2019.
- Won Best U.S. Edition of International Material - Asia at the Eisner Awards in 2020.
- Won the Best Manga Award at the Harvey Awards in 2020.

title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You
blurb:
Aijou Rentaro tried and tried again, but after asking a hundred girls out on a date, he was rejected every single time. In desperation, he prays for guidance…only to be told by a god that his rejections were due to some cosmic error! Now the god is going to set things right by making sure that Aijou gets one hundred dates. Except, as things often do with gods, the dates come with a catch: one hundred girls are destined to be Aijou’s soulmate, and unless he returns their feelings each and every time, they’ll die in horrible accidents! Sure enough, girls start confessing their love to Aijou left and right. But how is he supposed to choose?! He doesn’t want to kill anyone! When he looks at each potential soulmate, it feels like a bolt of lightning. Can someone really love a hundred other people? This hilarious romantic comedy takes the harem concept to a wild extreme!



Note: Won second place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category

title: Time Stop Hero
blurb: Just when Kuzuno Sekai hits rock bottom in his life, he’s transported to a video-game-like fantasy world and given the ability to stop time with a game controller! Lifting skirts, stealing cash, escaping prison–sounds like a pretty good deal, except for the catch. His ability to stop time allows him to stretch a moment into months, but in the world’s regular flow of time–where everyone else functions–he only has three days to accomplish some goal that isn’t specified. If he doesn’t reach that goal before the world’s three-day timer hits zero, he has no idea what fate awaits him!

title: Dandadan
blurb:
Momo Ayase strikes up an unusual friendship with her school’s UFO fanatic, whom she nicknames “Okarun” because he has a name that is not to be said aloud. While Momo believes in spirits, she thinks aliens are nothing but nonsense. Her new friend, meanwhile, thinks the exact opposite. To settle matters, the two set out to prove each other wrong—Momo to a UFO hotspot and Okarun to a haunted tunnel! What unfolds next is a beautiful story of young love…and oddly horny aliens and spirits?

 

Note: Nominated for the 15th Manga Taisho Award in 2022.

title: Berserk
blurb:
His name is Guts, the Black Swordsman, a feared warrior spoken of only in whispers. Bearer of a gigantic sword, an iron hand, and the scars of countless battles and tortures, his flesh is also indelibly marked with The Brand, an unholy symbol that draws the forces of darkness to him and dooms him as their sacrifice. But Guts won't take his fate lying down; he'll cut a crimson swath of carnage through the ranks of the damned—and anyone else foolish enough to oppose him! Accompanied by Puck the Elf, more an annoyance than a companion, Guts relentlessly follows a dark, bloodstained path that leads only to death...or vengeance.



Notes:
- Volumes 1-5 contain the 16 prequel chapters 0A - 0P.
- Chapter 83 was omitted from Volume 13 due to the author’s request.
- Volume 14 includes “Berserk: The Prototype”.
- Due to the author's passing, starting from Chapter 365, the manga is illustrated by Studio Gaga (Miura's assistants) and supervised by Kouji Mori (a close friend of Miura's).

title: Osoraku Kanojo wa Ore no Aniki wo Neratteru
blurb:
A high school guy who doesn't trust girls anymore has been tricked too many times by girls who just wanted to get close to his good-looking older brother. After all that, he decides he’ll never trust a girl again.

But then, a pretty girl in his class suddenly starts talking to him a lot. Is she just trying to get to his brother too…? Or does she actually mean something else?

title: Heibon de Arifureta, Shiawase na Renai.
blurb: This is a sweet, heartwarming romance between a young high school couple: Yukari Mishima, the school's idol, and Yamato Onodera, a boy who tends to fly under the radar. It is a relationship you can’t help but want to root for.

title: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun
blurb: Iruma Suzuki has always been eager to please, even at the cost of his well-being. Worst yet, he's the son of two selfish parents who end up selling him to a demon. Thanks to their totally irresponsible actions, Iruma has found himself living in the Netherworld, where he must live and attend school as the grandson of an older demon. Luckily, his new, doting grandfather is there to help, but Iruma will have to figure out how to blend in with his demonic classmates or risk getting eaten. All he needs to do is subjugate rival classmates, summon familiars, and do other typical demon things while never revealing that he's human… Piece of cake, right?

title: A Girlfriend Was Forced Upon Me, The Forever Loner
blurb: On my 24th birthday, I come home to a girl asking to be my lover!! From middle school onward, I've been a "loner". I had no idea why this girl would want to be with me, but eventually it comes out that she's from my mom's company and she asked her to do this?! She says no to my mom= Mom is sad+ workplace is awkward... Now begins the story of two people trying to be in a fake relationship!

title: Nakama ni Uragirare Shokei Sareta Shireijutsushi, Undead-ka Shiteita Eiyuu 10000-nin wo Sosei Shi Saikyou no Oukoku wo Tsukuri Fukushuu wo Kaishi Suru: Anei no Gyokuza ni Eirei wa Tsudou
blurb: After defeating the Demon King, the necromancer Crow was betrayed by his comrades and buried in the "Abyss." However, he resurrected himself by transforming the miasma into his own power, and completely revived 10,000 heroic spirits in a city that had once been destroyed by a god. Then, he gathered the strongest army, who swore absolute loyalty to him, and built his own kingdom. Crow begins his merciless revenge against his traitors and the god who was behind it all. An overwhelming dark fantasy begins...!

title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: The JOJOLands
blurb: The stage is set on a volcanic island in the Pacific Ocean, Hawaii. Jodio Joestar, a young boy living on Oahu Island, harbors the ambition to become a great millionaire. The clue to his goal lies in reaching the pinnacle of the mechanisms of this world. What means will he choose to achieve his objective?

title: Kurotsuki no Yaergnacht
blurb: While on his way home from an interview, unemployed, unmotivated, jaded 18-year-old Inumata Shinogi encounters the beautiful lady and evil spirit Yaergnacht Finsternnis. She demands him to either marry her or die on the spot. He must command the battle against enemies of humanityーthe apostles of god (Highlander), and save the world with his wife!! Battle fantasy with the infatuated strongest kuudere beauty, start!

title: My Isekai Life: I Gained a Second Character Class and Became the Strongest Sage in the World!
blurb: Whether at the office or at home, corporate drone Yuji Sano works all the time. So when his home PC flashes a message about him being summoned to another world, Yuji restarts his machine...only to find that he's inadvertently accepted the summons! Now in a fantasy world far removed from paperwork and computers, Yuji has just one thing on his mind: waking up from what he thinks is a dream and getting back to the mountain of work he left behind! But this other world has other plans for Yuji, who quickly discovers his Monster Tamer character class allows him to befriend slimes! And thanks to their number, those slimes help him absorb so much magical knowledge that he gains a second character class in the blink of an eye! How will Yuji wield his power now that he's the greatest sage the realm has ever known?! And what about all that paperwork?!

title: Akanabe-sensei wa Tereshirazu
blurb: Koki Sakieda is an assistant for Akira Akanebe, a manga artist he admires, who always tries to praise him in some way. Sakieda is worried that he will end up falling in love with her if this situation continues. Then Akanebe unexpectedly asks him to go out with her....... The story depicts the daily life of Akanebe-sensei, who lavishes praise on Sakieda without embarrassment, and Sakieda, who tries to accept it all gracefully.

title: Centuria
blurb:
Sold into slavery by his own mother, Julian has known nothing but pain and brutality. All that changes when, aboard a slave ship, he experiences the kindness and the tender touch of a loving person for the first time. But fate has plans for Julian in the blood awakening of an ancient god who strikes a cruel bargain: an innocent life in exchange for extraordinary powers—ones he must use to protect a helpless baby in a cruel and violent world!



Notes:
- Ninth place at the Next Manga Award in the Web Manga Category in 2024.
- Second place at the Next Manga Award in the Web Manga Category in 2025.
- Won the Daruma Award for Best Suspense/Thriller Manga at Japan Expo in 2026.

title: All My Neighbors are Convinced the Female Knight from My Rice Field Is My Wife
blurb: Jin Mita lives as a farmer in a small town in the countryside. One morning, he discovers a female knight collapsed in his rice paddy. Her name is Seraphim, and it appears that she has come from another world. She knows nothing about how this world works and has nowhere to go. Unable to just ignore her plight, Jin suggests that she live with him, leading to his neighbors believing that she's his wife! Farm work under the sun, and meals made with fresh ingredients...this is the start of a story about living a relaxing life with a female knight in the countryside!

title: Tsumiki Ogami's Not-So-Ordinary Life
blurb:
Yutaka Shinso is constantly worried about what other people think of him. Hoping to turn over a new leaf, he changes high schools, but there’s something strange afoot: vampires, ogres, and all manner of supernatural beings walk the halls! Yutaka is particularly drawn to Tsumiki Ogami, a confident and popular werewolf. Will Tsumiki be the one to help Yutaka overcome his insecurities?



Note:
- Placed third in the Tsugimanga 2024 Award in the Print Manga Category.

title: Walking Home with You
blurb: During his time in middle school, Shun was a well-known soccer player, but an injury sidelined him, making it impossible not only to play soccer but also to engage in any physical activity. Upon entering high school, he grew weary of continually turning down invitations to various clubs. Frustrated, he absentmindedly expressed his desire to just go home one day.  Hearing this, a girl named Naoki invited him to join the "Hyper Go-Home Club". They ended up gradually walking home together, and the romantic comedy unfolds.

title: Osananajimi BIG LOVE
blurb:
I once had a childhood friend who was a cute angel. However, when we met again, many years later, she had become a flamboyant gal. A yuri story between two childhood friends.



Note: Originally self-published, it was collected for a commercial volume release on 2024-09-26.

title: Yane no Shita no Artemis
blurb:
A prodigy of science and a solitary genius—yet terrible at so many things!?
When the poor university student Sanosuke Saraki started at a new part-time job at his old high school, he unexpectedly reunites with Koharu Kobachi, a classmate that he admired as a brilliant genius. However, this supposed genius is now a "5th year high school student" who must repeat her senior year for the second time…! Saraki's mission is to "help Koharu graduate by the end of the year." A coming-of-age story about starting over with a 20-year-old high school student!

title: Gal to Dungeon to Shuukai Okure no Tansaku Eiyuutan
So you weren't into me?!
blurb: Okabe vowed to focus on his studies in high school, but for whatever reason, the girls around him keep sending him mixed signals…

title: Bus for Two
blurb:
Two childhood friends share a bus ride in silence. Can they learn to talk to each other again?

Shunpei lives in a rural town in the middle of nowhere. His class has been together every year since they started school until one classmate, An, leaves to attend a private junior high. But Shunpei still sees An every day on the bus to their remote neighborhood. After years of drifting apart, Shunpei and An finally start talking again.

On the bus, Shunpei spends his time dozing off while An spends her time studying. The disappearance of a local vending machine sparks a conversation, and the pair break their silence for the first time in years! After several awkward attempts at conversation, they fall into a new routine of bus-ride banter. Can their old friendship be renewed? And could this be the start of something more?

title: Cool na Eikoku Bishoujo wa Orenchi ni Homestay Shitai Rashii
blurb:
High school boy Shouhei Miyamoto comes from a distinguished family with a long history.
One day, a foreign exchange student from England named Eleanor arrives to stay with the Miyamoto family!
Eleanor is cool and fluent in Japanese, but it seems she came to Japan with a hidden agenda beyond simply learning about Japanese culture…?
A heart-pounding, cross-cultural cohabitation romantic comedy featuring a cool British beauty!

title: Chronicles of an Aristocrat Reborn in Another World
blurb: After dying in the act of stopping a crime in modern Japan, our hero is reincarnated as Cain von Silford, third son of a noble family in a world of swords and sorcery. In his new life, all children receive a blessing from the gods…but Cain is unexpectedly blessed with an absolutely enormous, over-the-top cornucopia of magical powers. If his dream of traveling the world as a free spirit is to come true, he can’t reveal too much of his potential to the wrong people. A light-hearted, escapist adventure in another world begins!

title: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead
blurb:
Surviving a zombie apocalypse beats being a wage slave any day! After spending years slaving away for a soul-crushing company, Akira's life has lost its luster. He lives in a trash-filled apartment, his pay is abysmal, and he can't even muster up the nerve to confess his love to his beautiful co-worker. But when a zombie apocalypse ravages his town, it gives him the push he needs to live for himself. Now Akira's on a mission to complete all 100 items on his bucket list before he...well, kicks the bucket.



Note: Volume 1 contains a bonus chapter titled "Sakura Mochi Of The Dead" 
Note: Volume 4 contains a bonus chapter titled "Show Club of the Dead"

title: Tenkaichi: The Greatest Warrior Under the Rising Sun
blurb: This is not history as we know it. The year is 1600. Ten years have passed since Oda Nobunaga unified the whole of Japan. When Nobunaga realizes he is nearing the end of his life, he announces that he will hand over the reins of power to whoever brings him the strongest warrior. The generals, whose dreams of conquering the country had been crushed, put up their own strongest warriors and aim to become the king of the country! The first match is peerless spear wielder Honda Tadakatsu (sponsored by Tokugawa leyasu) vs. evolving prodigy Miyamoto Musashi (sponsored by Chosokabe Motochika)!!

title: Backstabbed in a Backwater Dungeon: My Party Tried to Kill Me, But Thanks to an Infinite Gacha I Got LVL 9999 Friends and Am Out For Revenge
blurb: A kid named Light is the only human member of the adventuring party Legion of Races, but humans are by far the weakest race in his world. When his comrades abandon him to the lowest levels of a dungeon, Light resorts to the gift of Infinite Gacha to create a harem of Lvl 9999 allies! With his powerful and beautiful new friends by his side, can Light escape the dungeon and exact vengeance upon the Legion of Races…and the entire world?

title: Akane-banashi
blurb:
Rakugo--the ultimate form of storytelling, where everything in a story is expressed with just your body and words. Shinta and his daughter Akane have been seduced by this wonderful form of classical entertainment. Having observed her father strive to pass the shin'uchi rakugo test, Akane will take her own steps into this unique world!



Notes:
- Ranked 3rd in the 8th Next Manga Awards print manga category in 2022.
- Ranked 4th in the Kono Manga ga Sugoi! 2023 guidebook for male readers.
- Ranked 3rd in the Nationwide Bookstore Employees' Recommended Comics of 2023.
- Ranked 2nd in the 16th Manga Taisho in 2023.
- Nominated for the 47th Kodansha Manga Award in the shounen category in 2023.
- Included in the New York Public Library's 2023 Best Books for Teens.
- Included in YALSA's 2024 Great Graphic Novels for Teens.

title: Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi.
blurb:
Sometimes, when life is hard, you just need a "friend."

Working at a game company, Rihito Otsuka (23), is a "normal" guy who is a steady presence on and off the job. Noa Saotome (27) is a "hard-core" woman who likes to go all out at everything she does. Two people who usually wouldn't get along become "friends" by chance...? The is the start of an workplace "friendship" comedy that's a little sweet but also a little heavy!

title: MAD
blurb: Mysterious alien life-forms invade Earth! Most of humanity is wiped off the face of the planet. John, his sister, and the remaining survivors hope to find a new world to inhabit… But one day, they’re targeted by aliens again!

title: Akira Failing in Love
blurb: Akira returns to the countryside for high school with a plan to win the heart of her childhood crush! They're both fools in love… because she's too dense to figure out he likes her back!

title: Mayonaka ni Aishiteyo
blurb:
“Sex makes you sleepy” —the night I took the plunge, believing those words, was a secret, sweet remedy just for me.

Subaru, a high school teacher suffering from insomnia, turns to a lesbian sex service in desperation to get some sleep. There, she meets Tsuki, an escort who provides her with the ultimate comfort, but later, she shows up at her school as an administrative staff member—!? A secret yuri romantic comedy about an insomniac female teacher and a lesbian prostitute who heal each other’s lonely nights!

title: Yoimiya Nagi ga Manager ni Yashoku wo Tsukuru Wake
